parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: The sphere represents the Earth on the globe, made of plastic with printed geographical details.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main display surface showing continents, countries, and oceans. It rotates around its axis for educational use.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate freely around its tilted axis within the supporting frame.

parts.name: Circle (Other)
parts.Basic_description: A circular metallic ring that holds the globe sphere in place and allows it to rotate.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and defines the rotational axis of the globe.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed relative to the base but allows the sphere to rotate within it.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The wooden base body supports the entire globe structure, including the stand and frame.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and elevation to the globe, ensuring it remains upright and balanced.
parts.Movement_description: It is stationary and does not move during normal use.
